retrieval_policy.kickoff_dependency_policy: The first unit must remain completable using only manager-authored local materials and ordinary local C++ tooling.
later_retrieval_requirements: Use an authorized retriever and record the exact URL, retrieval outcome, stable artifact location, content hash, retrieval time, and applicable license or terms.
Keep failed or unavailable retrieval results as explicit evidence rather than relabeling a URL as available content.
Classify each retrieved item as an index, lecture, reading, assignment, solution, or supplemental resource before changing the unit graph.
Verify official status, title, order, dependencies, and content independently before promoting any resource record to a course unit.
Audit for solutions, hidden graders, sealed references, secrets, and third-party student files before release to a learner view.
retrieval_policy.restricted_content_policy: Do not bypass authentication, access controls, robots restrictions, license limits, or repository boundaries. Restricted or unclear content remains blocked.
retrieval_policy.student_release_gate: Only provenance-recorded, license-compatible, answer-safe material may enter student_safe/.
retrieval_policy.fallback: If later retrieval fails, retain the blocked status and design a properly labeled self-contained manager-authored unit; do not fabricate source content or official structure.
